messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a bunch of billing tickets where the Console attributes requests to the wrong project. looks like the UI shows project=platform-team but token introspect says project=customer-app
kevin: saw that earlier today in prod traces. attribution currently falls back to an incoming header when token claims are missing/stripped
sanjay: right — our auth-proxy sometimes drops the claims and we rely on X-Project header. that explains the mismatch
maria: example: upstream sends `X-Project: platform-team` but introspect returns `{\"project\": \"customer-app\"}`. console shows the header value which skews quotas/cost center :/
kevin: oof. two problems: (1) incorrect quota enforcement + billing, (2) console telem/end-user visibility is misleading
sanjay: short-term fix: change attribution precedence to prefer token introspect claim `project` when present. fallback to header only if no validated claim
maria: agree. also want telemetry to understand how often header != token. add metrics: `attribution_source{introspect,header,default}` and `attribution_mismatch_total`
kevin: +1. also add a sampled trace (100/sec cap) for mismatch cases so we can inspect partners that intentionally set header
maria: UX change: in request detail flyout show "Attribution source: introspect/header/default" and when mismatch show a small info badge "possible mismatch" — avoid alarmism
sanjay: implementation notes: change in auth-exchange service to set X-Effective-Project before routing. runtime precedence: introspect -> org-override-flag -> header -> anonymous
kevin: org-override-flag? explain
sanjay: some enterprise partners intentionally meta-route via header. we need an org-level compatibility toggle to preserve header precedence for those who rely on it
maria: good call. expose in Console under Org Settings: "Allow header-based attribution (legacy)" default OFF for new orgs
kevin: telemetry+rollout plan: 1) add metrics and tracing (measurable in datadog) 2) unit/integration tests 3) canary 1% traffic remap precedence and monitor 48h 4) console UX flag + docs
maria: I'll draft the rollout doc. low-risk canary but watch quotas closely
kevin: will coordinate with Billing team before canary. want alert thresholds for unusual quota changes or billing delta
maria: suggested alert: if `attribution_mismatch_total` rate increases >5x baseline or if any single project sees quota burn delta >20%/hour during canary
sanjay: also add a feature-flag so we can flip per-cluster while debugging
maria: created ticket INF-7891 to track: "Canonicalize project attribution to token claims, add telemetry, expose org compatibility flag"
dev-console-bot: Created INF-7891: "Canonicalize project attribution to token claims" assigned to sanjay, maria
kevin: any BC risk for integrators that deliberately relied on header ordering? needs comms and a migration path
sanjay: we'll ship compatibility flag and a deprecation timeline. recommend 90-day notice before changing default for existing orgs
maria: timeline estimate: auth-exchange PR + tests ~1d, telemetry + dashboards ~0.5d, console flag + UX ~1d, canary infra + docs ~0.5d. target ship Wed next week if no blockers
kevin: I'll sync with Billing and Prod-SRE for the canary window
maria: @finance-leads can you monitor billing signals during canary?
finance-leads: happy to; ping us 24h before toggle and share runbook
kevin: will post canary plan in #release-war-room and link INF-7891
maria: thanks all — can we keep this thread small and move detailed infra/PR links into INF-7891?
kevin: yup, will do
sanjay: will start the PR and link here when ready
maria: thanks!
